description: Verify a sealed BetsBeats pick from its SHA-256 commitment hash (full 64 hex characters, or a prefix of 16 or more). Before the pick settles this only confirms the hash exists and returns sealed_at and kickoff_at. After settlement it returns the revealed preimage, recomputes SHA-256 on the server and reports matches=true/false, plus the result and a verify_url. For adults 21+ only. Entertainment and analysis; no wins are promised and past results do not predict future ones. BetsBeats does not take bets.

hash.description: Commitment hash: 64 hex characters, or a unique prefix of at least 16.
